name: Group quilt
summary: A quilt for the group, one square each: friends have stitched theirs, yours is a dashed patch you try patterns and threads on, then stitch in while a needle runs the seam; the last square sews in the label.
useWhen: end of a semester or a trip and the group wants a keepsake they all make together
'we should make something for the group chat', a shared creative moment with everyone's own piece
dontUseWhen: a recap of what happened (use wrapped or album)
a one-person drawing (use a sticker or sprite tool)

params.title: string
params.label: sewn-in label once finished
params.squares: up to 9 x {name, pattern: stripes|dots|zigzag|checks|stars|hearts|waves|rice or '' if not stitched yet, color (0-5), said}
